verdict: Purchases jumped this week, but efficiency slipped and needs steadying.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $7,120.96 in revenue on $1,483.14 in spend — a 4.8x return on ad spend for the period. Purchases spiked 50% week-over-week, but that surge is already softening, and the weekly return on ad spend fell 42% as the higher-volume days were not as efficient; the purchase pattern remains inconsistent rather than a reliable daily floor. Your Google Business Profile showed two consecutive days of zero engagement actions on August 6–7, against a prior daily average of roughly 19 — this points to a possible listing issue rather than a natural slowdown, and we are investigating it now. Instagram reach has also trended downward over the past few weeks, a signal of creative fatigue, and fresh content is being introduced to address it — the live-cooking shoot scheduled for August 14 will directly feed new creative into the account.
